scores.notes: Tabernacle centred under a large cloud with tents radiating out, families resting by cooking fires and animals; painted to all edges, no lettering found.

Hatherley points with bandaged hands toward the burning whitewashed house and fire-engines; Holmes on the right is drawn with a gaunt profile and swept-back hair closely resembling Peter Cushing's screen Holmes. Lower-left edge fades to unpainted paper (accepted).
Peter steps from the bow with arms out toward a luminous Jesus with a lantern on the waves at night, disciples gripping the boat; no lettering or anatomy faults seen.

Faint pseudo-signature glyphs in the bottom-right corner; the group walks toward the viewer away from the fire with Hatherley turned from the blaze, reversing the asked hurry toward it; Holmes again has a Peter Cushing-like face. Bottom-right paper edge unpainted (accepted).

Bald Elisha in a fur mantle on the road near Bethel's gate with youths pointing and jeering on the right, calf shrine and watchers on rooftops; he faces the viewer rather than climbing toward the gate but the scene reads.
Job in torn tunic on an ash heap of potsherds looks up into a dust whirlwind with lightning; the storm holds no face or human shape.
Darius kneels at the pit rim reaching down, attendants with rope and lamp, Daniel unharmed among calm lions; odd stone steps into the den but nothing contradictory enough to fault.

Moses with staff and families carrying children walk the wet seabed beside a towering water wall, a far left wall and the fire pillar behind; seen from the front rather than behind, left wall distant, but the crossing is shown.
Moses gestures beside Aaron in ephod and breastplate while a pig roots near tents and the tabernacle under glowing cloud; breastplate and headband carry no glyphs; no divine figure.

Pseudo-script scratched on the stone ledge at bottom right (and small marks bottom left); the mirror faces outward to the viewer and shows a different man's face while Paul looks at the viewer, contradicting his gazing into it.
Alice in yellow dress and pinafore stands with clasped hands on a wood path facing a grinning striped cat on a bough, cottage at left; no film-specific costume or lettering found.
Peter grips the lame man's right hand and raises him in the temple court, John beside, crowd and Roman soldiers behind; lower-left edge unpainted paper (accepted), no lettering.

Saul mid-throw with empty hands, but one spear flies through the air while a second red shaft is already lodged in the wall behind David's head with a red burst, two contradictory spears; smoke has no figure.

Bald Elisha in a fur mantle on the hill road with tunic-clad youths pointing from the gate, calf statue above and villagers in doorways; left and lower edges fade to white paper (accepted), no lettering found.
Moses with staff stretches his arm as towering water walls part over a dry seabed under night cloud with dawn glow; the walls hold sea creatures but no face or figure.
The father embraces his gaunt son in a whitewashed village lane while two servants bring a robe and sandals; hands and faces sound.
Moses raises an arm before the people moving out with donkeys and bundles below a mountain crowned by a radiant cloud; no faults seen.

Aaron and Hur support seated Moses' arms on the rocks while Israelites and Amalekites fight below; an inked signature-like scrawl sits in the bottom-right corner. Top-right corner shows unpainted paper (accepted).
Moses strikes with raised rod as water gushes from the pale cliff, Aaron beside him, people and goats drinking; headband ornament reads as a jewel, not glyphs.
Moses with staff stretches his arm as wind drives the sea back into a sandy path between waves at night; no figure in the wind or cloud.
Darius kneels pressing his ring into wax on the great stone over the den by lamp and torchlight, lords with signets behind; seal shows no inscription.
The bill Holmes holds, the papers, newspaper and framed-print captions carry pseudo-writing; Holmes's face closely resembles Peter Cushing. Edges fade pale at the right (accepted).
The printed slip Holmes holds and the papers on the table show pseudo-text; Holmes's profile closely resembles Peter Cushing. Bottom-right edge shows unpainted patches (accepted).

Alice at the tea-table under the tree facing a wide-eyed Hatter, March Hare and dozing Dormouse; the card in the Hatter's hatband carries a scribbled glyph. Left and right edges fade to white (accepted).
Holmes at his lamplit desk by the fire seen from the doorway; the open book, papers and newspapers show pseudo-writing, and his face closely resembles Peter Cushing.
Saul mid-throw and David dodging, but the spear lodged in the wall has its point facing back toward Saul with the butt end embedded; the smoke has no face or body.
